channel.title: Georgia Public Broadcasting - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Georgia Public Broadcasting (gpb.org)

item.title: How the West was won: K-pop's great assimilation gambit
item.description: The crossover hits stacking Grammy nods this year have little in common with the culture that birthed them — but they're winning the chart game.

item.title: GPB evening headlines for January 29, 2026
item.description: Fulton County officials are reeling after the FBI seized 700 boxes of ballots and other data from an elections warehouse. Republican and Democratic state lawmakers had very different reactions to the Trump administration's extraordinary move. An non-partisan, non-profit elections watchdog says the seizure will erode public confidence in the nation's voting system.

item.title: Senate fails to advance spending bills as Democrats push for DHS reforms
item.description: Senators blocked a package of six spending bills that includes funding for the Department of Homeland Security as Democrats continue to push for reforms to immigration enforcement.

item.title: Elected leaders react to federal agents' seizing 2020 election ballots from Fulton County
item.description: Hundreds of boxes full of ballots were loaded onto trucks and taken away. Fulton County leaders shared security concerns and next steps.

item.title: Georgia Today: FBI seized Fulton County ballots; Another winter storm watch; ICE protests in Macon
item.description: On the Jan. 29 edition: The FBI seized ballots and other election data from a Fulton County elections warehouse in Union City; Parts of Georgia are under another winter storm watch; And hundreds of ICE protesters marched in Macon last night.

item.title: Medicare Advantage insurers face new curbs on overcharges in Trump plan
item.description: Federal officials have a plan that could curb billions of dollars in overpayments to Medicare Advantage plans. But will they follow through on it?

item.title: The FBI executes a search warrant for 2020 election ballots in Georgia's Fulton County
item.description: The FBI on Wednesday executed a search warrant at the election center in Georgia's Fulton County, seeking ballots and other records from the 2020 election.

item.title: With his first Grammy nomination, Destin Conrad embraces personal evolution
item.description: Destin Conrad went from teen social media star to a musician touring the world on some of its biggest stages. In 2025, he put out both an R&B and jazz album and earned his first Grammy nomination.

item.title: How Democrats want to reform DHS — and why some Republicans are open to their demands
item.description: A spending agreement under consideration in the Senate would temporarily fund the Department of Homeland Security while lawmakers negotiate provisions to rein in federal immigration agents.

item.title: Trump sues IRS and Treasury for $10 billion over leaked tax information
item.description: President Trump is suing the IRS and Treasury Department for $10 billion, accusing them of failing to prevent a leak of his tax information to news outlets.
